rules: All locales: title is a single natural 'why' question without the series suffix (the tool appends it); numbers from the zh-TW title are kept identical; no facts beyond the zh-TW title/answer.
zh-TW: the episodes.json title unchanged, full-width ？ at the end; thumb ≤ 10 characters, the punchiest fragment.
en: 'Why does/is/did … ?' in Title Case, the phrasing people type into search; brand names as sold in the US (Costco, 7-Eleven, TSMC, NVIDIA, LINE); ≤ 70 characters; thumb ≤ 4 words.
ja: 「なぜ〇〇は〜のか？」 with full-width ？; katakana/market names (コストコ, セブン-イレブン, スタバ, TSMC, NVIDIA); ≤ 40 characters; thumb ≤ 10 characters.
ko: 「〇〇은/는 왜 ~할까?」 with ASCII ?; Hangul brand names where Koreans use them (코스트코, 세븐일레븐, 노키아, 엔비디아), Latin where they don't (TSMC, USB-C, AI); ≤ 40 characters; thumb ≤ 10 characters.

zh-CN: 「为什么……？」 in Simplified characters and mainland terms and names (高铁, 手机, 网速, 开市客, 诺基亚, 台积电, 英伟达, 谷歌, 宜家, 爱彼迎, 优衣库); 7-Eleven, iPhone, LINE, Netflix, Supreme, YouTube stay in Latin; ≤ 40 characters; thumb ≤ 10 characters.

Reframe only when the zh-TW premise is ordinary for that audience (their own country or daily habit); the re-asked question stays inside the zh-TW answer, and the reason is recorded in reframed.<locale>.
